There is no parking space offered with this property. WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK.

WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

There is no parking space offered with this property. WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. Full Market Value: £315,000 30% Share Price: £94,500 (rent £505.31 pcm) Minimum 5% Mortgage Deposit (30% share): £4,725 Approximate Service Charges: £275.98 pcm* Lease: 990 years ELIGIBILITY Shared Ownership gives first time buyers and those that do not currently own a home the opportunity to purchase a share in a new build or resales leasehold property. The purchaser pays a mortgage on the share they own and pays rent to a housing association on the remaining share. The combined mortgage and rent is usually less than you’d expect to pay if you bought a similar property outright although this is not a guarantee. To be eligible for shared ownership you would need to meet the following criteria: • Your annual household income does not exceed £90,000. • You have a deposit of at least 5% of the share value • You do not own another property or have your name on the deeds or a mortgage for a property worldwide. • This will be your only residence. • You are a permanent UK resident or have indefinite right to remain. *Service charges are estimated and may subject to change. Rent and service charges will be reviewed annually by your housing provider, usually on 1st April each year. There is no parking space offered with this property. WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

Pets may be permitted but only with prior consent from Clarion (which, unfortunately, can only be obtained once you are the property owner). WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

PRICING & AFFORDABILITY Full Market Value: £450,000 25% Share Price: £112,500 (rent £674.05pcm) Minimum 5% Mortgage Deposit (25% share): £5,625 Approximate Service Charges: £367.38pcm* Lease: 107 years remaining ELIGIBILITY Shared Ownership gives first time buyers and those that do not currently own a home the opportunity to purchase a share in a new build or resales leasehold property. The purchaser pays a mortgage on the share they own and pays rent to a housing association on the remaining share. The combined mortgage and rent is usually less than you’d expect to pay if you bought a similar property outright although this is not a guarantee. WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

The information in this document supersedes any information given verbally either in person or by telephone. Pets not permitted (except assistance animals). There is no parking space offered with this property. WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

Shared Ownership This superb modern home is available to buy from as little as £100,000 with a 25% share! Set within a distinctive modern development on Salter Street, this stunning third-floor apartment offers a bright and thoughtfully arranged living space ideal for both relaxing and entertaining. The property benefits from a contemporary layout, with a spacious reception room featuring an attractive angular design that enhances natural light and creates a sense of openness. The double bedroom is generously proportioned and enjoys a private aspect, making it a comfortable retreat. PRICING & AFFORDABILITY Full Market Value: £400,000 25% Share Price: £100,000 (rent £862 pcm) Minimum 5% Mortgage Deposit (25% share): £5,125 Approximate Service Charges: £292 pcm* Lease: 997 years ELIGIBILITY Shared Ownership gives first time buyers and those that do not currently own a home the opportunity to purchase a share in a new build or resales leasehold property. The purchaser pays a mortgage on the share they own and pays rent to a housing association on the remaining share. The combined mortgage and rent is usually less than you’d expect to pay if you bought a similar property outright although this is not a guarantee. To be eligible for shared ownership you would need to meet the following criteria: • Your annual household income does not exceed £90,000. • You have a deposit of at least 5% of the share value • You do not own another property or have your name on the deeds or a mortgage for a property worldwide. • This will be your only residence. • You are a permanent UK resident or have indefinite right to remain. *Service charges are estimated and may subject to change. Rent and service charges will be reviewed annually by your housing provider, usually on 1st April each year. * This home can also be purchased outright (100% of the value) which is £400,000 and a purchaser would not need to meet the eligibility criteria listed above.

19804092.description: Come and celebrate 125 years of Southern Housing with us on Saturday, 17th October at 12pm. A special open day for you to enjoy drinks, delicious cakes, good vibes and a little something to take home, plus a special £125 reservation fee on the day*. Make this a moment that matters, and take the next step towards creating many more in your new home. Book your space ! A new collection of 1, 2 & 3 bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in North Peckham. Glengall Rise is an exciting new development on Glengall Road in the London Borough of Southwark offering a chance to live minutes away from Burgess Park and other green spaces. Benefits of living at Glengall Rise • Residents' only Brompton bike hire • Intelligent parcel lockers • 8th floor rooftop terrace - a great space to unwind while enjoying stunning London views • 2nd floor residents' podium with tables, benches and children's play area Designed to suit every lifestyle, these homes offer a versatile mix of layouts and features. Whether you're a first-time buyer, growing family or looking to downsize, you can do so at Glengall Rise without a compromise. Light-filled, open-plan layouts will help you make the most of space and will allow you to enjoy everyday living and entertaining. The development retains its original kiln chimney as a key architectural feature. Set between two buildings, selected Shared Ownership homes will feature stunning views of London and each home benefits from a balcony or a terrace. Wheelchair adaptable apartments Glengall Rise will offer several wheelchair adaptable apartments, designed to make living in London the best it can be. With great layout options that accommodate wheelchair users, rest assured you will find the perfect home. Speak to our sales team to find out more. Shared Ownership What are the benefits? Low deposit - you only pay from 5% of the share you are buying. Flexibility - you choose when you want to purchase extra share of your home. Accessibility - Shared Ownership helps you get a mortgage even with a lower salary. Lower costs - Monthly costs can work our cheaper than renting privately. To be eligible for Shared Ownership: Your household income must be no more than £90,000. You cannot own another property at the time of completing your purchase. You must have an offer on your current property to be able to reserve a new home. You must be over 18 years of age and able to obtain a mortgage. Priority will be given to those who live or work in the London Borough of Southwark You can read our buying guides for more information or listen to our podcast for on the go learning! Book your viewing today! *£125 reservation fee is only available for those who attend the event on the 17th October, 2026. To qualify, the memorandum of sale must be issued before the 1st November, 2026. Local Area Information North Peckham offers a mix of creativity, culture and community spirit. Spend weekends exploring Burgess Park (4 mins' walk away), catching exhibitions at South London Gallery, or trying local favourites from Peckham Levels to Rye Lane Market. For fitness fans Peckham has a wide range of gyms for all different interests. A little further in Bermondsey, explore the beer mile for undiscovered craft lagers, uncover hidden gems at Bermondsey antique market and immerse yourself in culture at the White Cube Gallery. In Elephant and Castle, check out the renowned Southwark Playhouse, BFI IMAX and many more bars and restaurants. Transport at Glengall Rise Packham Rye station is only 9 minutes away from your new home by bike. From there you can reach London Victoria in 13 minutes . Or, Elephant and Castle train station is a 9-minute bike ride away, from where you can get to: Liverpool Street in 13 minutes Farringdon in 9 minutes London Bridge in 4 minutes Nearest Bus stops St George's Way, Bird in Bush Road, and Trafalgar Avenue are within a 4-7 minute walk, served by multiple routes including the 149, 257, 294, 63, 78 and more All travel times and distances taken grom googlemaps.com and are subject to change.

WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

The open plan living/dining/kitchen area opens out onto the private west-facing balcony. The modern kitchen is fitted with integrated appliances. The generously sized bedroom boasts a fitted wardrobe. The separate utility cupboard is fitted with a washer/dryer. A collection of 1 & 2 bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in Brentford. Unfamiliar with Shared Ownership? Under the Shared Ownership scheme, you part-buy/part-rent your home, making it possible for first-time buyers and families to get on the property ladder. The minimum share you can purchase is 25% and the maximum is 75%. You will usually pay a mortgage on the part you own and a subsidized rent on the part you don't own. As your income rises, you can increase the share you own until you eventually own 100%. 20232355.description: Contemporary collection of 1-, 2-& 3-bedroom apartments Available through Shared Ownership Excellent transport connections across London Close to local amenities, parks, cafés and restaurants An ideal opportunity for first-time buyers Register your interest today! Violet Road offers a collection of contemporary 1-, 2-and 3-bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in the heart of E3. A brand-new opportunity to get onto the property ladder is now available in Tower Hamlets. Violet Road is an exciting new Shared Ownership development offering a contemporary collection of 1-, 2-and 3-bedroom apartments, perfectly suited to first-time buyers looking to own a home in one of East London's most vibrant locations. About the property: Designed for modern living, Violet Road will offer a collection of thoughtfully planned homes that combine style, comfort and convenience. Whether you're purchasing your first home or looking for more space, these contemporary apartments provide an exciting opportunity to enjoy life in one of East London's most well-connected neighbourhoods. Local Transport: Situated in the heart of E3, Violet Road benefits from excellent transport connections, with Devons Road DLR approximately a 4-minute walk away, Bromley-by-Bow Underground Station around an 8-minute walk and both Bow Road Underground Station and Bow Church DLR approximately 11 minutes away on foot. Residents can enjoy quick and convenient journeys to Canary Wharf, Stratford, Bank and the City, while a fantastic selection of cafés, restaurants, shops and green open spaces are all within easy reach. Why Shared Ownership: Shared Ownership makes homeownership more achievable with lower deposits and smaller monthly payments compared to buying outright. You purchase a share of your home and pay rent on the rest, offering both flexibility and security. 20241945.description: 2 bedrooms 2 modern bathrooms Open-plan living & kitchen with balcony access Private balcony Excellent transport links bike storage & playground The generously sized open-plan living and kitchen area forms the heart of the home. The living space flows seamlessly towards large windows and direct access to a private balcony, creating a light-filled environment perfect for relaxing or entertaining. The contemporary open-plan kitchen is fully fitted and provides ample worktop space, ideal for everyday cooking and dining. There are two well-proportioned bedrooms, both benefiting from excellent natural light through large windows. The main bedroom offers a peaceful retreat, while the second bedroom provides flexible additional living or sleeping space. The property features two modern bathrooms. One offers a bright, spa-like feel with stylish tiling, a walk-in shower, and a contemporary basin. The second bathroom includes a full-sized bath with shower, continuing the clean, modern aesthetic with high-quality finishes. Residents also enjoy practical amenities including secure bike storage and a communal playground, ideal for families or those who value outdoor space within the development. Located with excellent transport links, Canary Wharf Station, Westferry Station and Mile End are all nearby, with a selection of bus stops right outside. This makes commuting across London straightforward and convenient.

20251649.description: Bright & homely 1st floor apartment Generously sized open-plan kitchen & living space Private balcony with easy access Modern bathroom with spa-like tiling Excellent transport links (Stratford, Mile End, Devons Road buses) Welcome to this bright and homely first-floor apartment offering a wonderfully light and spacious feel throughout. The property comprises one generously proportioned bedroom and a modern, bright bathroom featuring spa-like tiling. The open-plan kitchen is generously sized and flows seamlessly into a large living area that enjoys abundant natural light and direct, easy access onto a generous-sized balcony, perfect for enjoying the outdoors. Residents benefit from excellent transport links, with Stratford, Devons Road and Mile End all easily accessible, plus a selection of bus stops right on the doorstep. A light, airy and well-presented home in a convenient East London location.

20263794.description: Now Launched - 1 & 2 bedroom apartments available with lower rents! A brand-new collection of one and two bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in South Bermondsey. Designed for modern city living, Varcoe Corner gives you the best of both worlds - a vibrant local community with quick and easy connections into central London. Benefits of living at Varcoe Corner Lower rents at 1.75% for 1 beds and 2.50% for 2 beds Private balcony or terrace and integrated appliances to each home Communal roof terrace with panoramic views of the London skyline Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) rating is B Secure residents' cycle storage Wheelchair adaptable homes available Welcome to Varcoe Corner, a collection of thoughtfully designed apartments combining practical layout with contemporary finishes. Stylish kitchens with integrated appliances and built-in-mirrored wardrobes to the main bedrooms create a comfortable and functional home. It's central location, elevated views across London and excellent transport links make it an ideal choice. Beyond your front door, there is a convenience store next to the development to purchase daily essentials. Stay active and push your limits on the court at nearby Padel Box Bermondsey or you can explore open green spaces at nearby Burgess Park. Shared Ownership What are the benefits? Low deposit - you only pay from 5% of the share you are buying. Flexibility - you choose when you want to purchase extra share of your home. Accessibility - Shared Ownership helps you get a mortgage even with a lower salary. Lower costs - Monthly costs can work our cheaper than renting privately. To be eligible for Shared Ownership: Your household income must be no more than £90,000. You cannot own another property at the time of completing your purchase. You must have an offer on your current property to be able to reserve a new home. You must be over 18 years of age and able to obtain a mortgage. You can read our buying guides for more information or listen to our podcast for on the go learning! Register your interest and book a viewing to find out more *Images are for illustrative purposes only. Local Area Information South Bermondsey is a lively neighbourhood, with its enviable Zone 2 location the development is perfectly placed to explore. Bermondsey Street offers boutique shops and galleries, while Maltby Street Market is perfect for foodies. Southwark Park provides green open spaces, and nearby creative hubs and cultural venues add to the area's charm. South Bermondsey station is just a 7-minute walk away and only a 15-minute cycle to Elephant & Castle station, for when you want to venture into central London or further afield. Transport at Varcoe Corner South Bermondsey Station is only a 7-minute walk away. You can be at: London Bridge in 5 minutes Peckham Rye in 5 minutes Crystal Palace in 28 minutes Beckenham Junction in 33 minutes All times and distances are taken from Google Maps and should be taken as an estimate.

The current owner informs us that there will be a temporary suspension of parking in the future for work to be carried out. WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

WHAT IS SHARED OWNERSHIP ? Shared Ownership is a housing scheme designed to help homebuyers who are unable to afford the cost of buying a property outright on the open market. Properties may be sold off-plan or new build direct from housing associations, or pre-owned from existing shared owners. The rules and terms of the scheme are set by the Greater London Authority (GLA) in London and Homes England outside of London. IS SHARED OWNERSHIP FOR YOU ? The GLA and Homes England set the eligibility criteria for Shared Ownership, but broadly speaking you must: 1. Not own another property in the UK or any other country. 2. Have a household income that falls below £90,000 (£80,000 threshold outside the M25). Every property will have a minimum income level too, determined by its value, rent and service charge costs. In most cases you will need to meet or exceed the given minimum income. 3. Have access to a minimum deposit of 10% of the share being purchased (a minimum deposit of 5% of the share being purchased may be acceptable depending on individual financial status). 4. Be in full time permanent employment. 5. Be a British, EU or EEA Citizen or have indefinite leave to remain in the UK. 6. Have a good credit history.

The purchaser pays a mortgage on the share they own and pays rent to a housing association on the remaining share. The development consists of two impressive apartment buildings set around a central communal garden. There are also roof terraces with great views to enjoy. There's a selection of 3 bedroom apartment designs and positions but all offer spacious accommodation, comprehensive specification and genuine value in the local market. Shared ownership is the easier way to get a place of your own. You buy the financial share that works for your budget and pay an affordable monthly fee to us for the bit you haven't bought, with monthly costs often much less than privately renting. You also need a smaller deposit, as it's based on the price of the share you buy, rather than the full value...plus we're now boosting this by up to £7,500 on top of what you've already got. Just like owning outright, when you want to move on you simply sell your share for its market value at that time. Or, when you're ready, you can buy more shares...until it's all yours. Initially, you can buy a share between 17.5% - 75%, according to what you can afford. Some lowest cost examples, based on a home with a full market value of £600,000: 17.5% share at £105,000: 10% deposit of £10,500 (£5250 from you + £5250 from us); monthly mortgage of £477* and monthly fee of £1134 = £1611/month 20% share at £120,000: 10% deposit of £12,000 (£6000 from you + £6000 from us); monthly mortgage of £545* and monthly fee of £1100 = £1645/month 25% share at £150,000: 10% deposit of £15,000 (£7500 from you + £7500 from us); monthly mortgage of £681* and monthly fee of £1031 = £1712/month 30% share at £180,000: 10% deposit would be £18,000 (£10,500 from you + £7500 from us); monthly mortgage of £818* and monthly fee of £963 = £1781/month It really works, with hundreds of thousands of people across the country having already bought their home this way. Our experienced, professional team is here to ensure that things go as smoothly as possible. Call us 9-5 Monday-Friday, or email us anytime, to discuss how it could work for you. *Based on a mortgage rate of 5% and a term of 35 years. Please note, rates and criteria vary. A service charge is payable in addition to the above. Read full description Less description Eligibility Eligibility Criteria for Shared Ownership To qualify for a Shared Ownership home, there are a few key requirements you need to meet: - Age: You must be at least 18 years old. - Income: If you live outside of London, your total household income must be less than £80,000 per year. In London, the income cap is £90,000 per year. - Property Ownership: You cannot currently own another home. Shared Ownership is mainly for first-time buyers, but if you do own a property (in the UK or abroad), you need to be in the process of selling it. - Affordability: You should not be able to afford to buy a suitable home on the open market. - Financial History: You must have a good credit history, with no outstanding debts or County Court Judgements (CCJs), and show that you can afford the payments and costs involved. - Deposit & Costs: Typically, you’ll need a deposit of 5-10% of the share you're purchasing and access to around £4,000 to cover additional costs like legal fees and surveys, although this figure can vary. Who Gets Priority for Shared Ownership? Shared Ownership is available to anyone who meets the eligibility criteria, including first-time buyers, people looking to move up, downsize, or relocate. While there are no priority groups in areas where Shared Ownership homes are in short supply, military personnel and former members of the Armed Forces (discharged within the last two years) are given priority under government schemes. In some cases, local authorities may require that applicants who live or work in the area be given preference, depending on local planning policies. Affordability & Eligibility Check Each applicant will need to complete an affordability and eligibility check with an independent mortgage advisor. Once you submit an enquiry, we will send you a link to start this process. 642130:1726.0.description: Come and celebrate 125 years of Southern Housing with us on Saturday, 17th October at 12pm. A special open day for you to enjoy drinks, delicious cakes, good vibes and a little something to take home, plus a special £125 reservation fee on the day*. Make this a moment that matters, and take the next step towards creating many more in your new home. Book your space! A new collection of 1, 2 & 3 bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in North Peckham. Benefits of living at Glengall Rise • Residents' only Brompton bike hire • Intelligent parcel lockers • 8th floor rooftop terrace - a great space to unwind while enjoying stunning London views • 2nd floor residents' podium with tables, benches and children's play area Designed to suit every lifestyle, these homes offer a versatile mix of layouts and features. Whether you're a first-time buyer, growing family or looking to downsize, you can do so at Glengall Rise without a compromise. Light-filled, open-plan layouts will help you make the most of space and will allow you to enjoy everyday living and entertaining. The development retains its original kiln chimney as a key architectural feature. Set between two buildings, selected Shared Ownership homes will feature stunning views of London and each home benefits from a balcony or a terrace. Wheelchair adaptable apartments Glengall Rise will offer several wheelchair adaptable apartments, designed to make living in London the best it can be. With great layout options that accommodate wheelchair users, rest assured you will find the perfect home. Speak to our sales team to find out more. Shared Ownership What are the benefits? Low deposit - you only pay from 5% of the share you are buying. Flexibility - you choose when you want to purchase extra share of your home. Accessibility - Shared Ownership helps you get a mortgage even with a lower salary. Lower costs - Monthly costs can work our cheaper than renting privately. Book your viewing today! Local area information North Peckham offers a mix of creativity, culture and community spirit. Spend weekends exploring Burgess Park (4 mins' walk away), catching exhibitions at South London Gallery, or trying local favourites from Peckham Levels to Rye Lane Market. For fitness fans Peckham has a wide range of gyms for all different interests. A little further in Bermondsey, explore the beer mile for undiscovered craft lagers, uncover hidden gems at Bermondsey antique market and immerse yourself in culture at the White Cube Gallery. In Elephant and Castle, check out the renowned Southwark Playhouse, BFI IMAX and many more bars and restaurants. Transport at Glengall Rise Packham Rye station is only 9 minutes away from your new home by bike. From there you can reach London Victoria in 13 minutes. Or, Elephant and Castle train station is a 9-minute bike ride away, from where you can get to: Liverpool Street in 13 minutes Farringdon in 9 minutes London Bridge in 4 minutes Nearest Bus stops St George's Way, Bird in Bush Road, and Trafalgar Avenue are within a 4-7 minute walk, served by multiple routes including the 149, 257, 294, 63, 78 and more All travel times and distances taken grom googlemaps.com and are subject to change. *£125 reservation fee is only available for those who attend the event on the 17th October, 2026. To qualify, the memorandum of sale must be issued before the 1st November, 2026. You cannot own another property at the time of completing your purchase. You must have an offer on your current property to be able to reserve a new home. The property is on the twenty-eighth floor and has a twenty-two-foot reception room with stylish, open-plan kitchen featuring handle-less units and integrated appliances. A door leads out onto a west-facing balcony which offers a view of the meandering Thames plus The Shard, and the towers of the Square Mile, in the distance. There is a generously-sized bedroom and an attractive, fully-tiled bathroom. A pair of storage/utility cupboards have been provided and the energy-efficiency rating is very good, thanks to modern insulation standards, high performance glazing and a communal heating/hot water system. The development has a lounge/work space and roof terrace at thirtieth-floor level plus extensive cycle storage in the basement. 658885:1314.0.description: Come and celebrate 125 years of Southern Housing with us on Saturday, 17th October at 12pm. A special open day for you to enjoy drinks, delicious cakes, good vibes and a little something to take home, plus a special £125 reservation fee on the day*. Make this a moment that matters, and take the next step towards creating many more in your new home. Book your space! A new collection of 1, 2 & 3 bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in North Peckham. Benefits of living at Glengall Rise • Residents' only Brompton bike hire • Intelligent parcel lockers • 8th floor rooftop terrace - a great space to unwind while enjoying stunning London views • 2nd floor residents' podium with tables, benches and children's play area Designed to suit every lifestyle, these homes offer a versatile mix of layouts and features. Whether you're a first-time buyer, growing family or looking to downsize, you can do so at Glengall Rise without a compromise. Light-filled, open-plan layouts will help you make the most of space and will allow you to enjoy everyday living and entertaining. The development retains its original kiln chimney as a key architectural feature. Set between two buildings, selected Shared Ownership homes will feature stunning views of London and each home benefits from a balcony or a terrace. Wheelchair adaptable apartments Glengall Rise will offer several wheelchair adaptable apartments, designed to make living in London the best it can be. With great layout options that accommodate wheelchair users, rest assured you will find the perfect home. Speak to our sales team to find out more. Shared Ownership What are the benefits? Low deposit - you only pay from 5% of the share you are buying. Flexibility - you choose when you want to purchase extra share of your home. Accessibility - Shared Ownership helps you get a mortgage even with a lower salary. Lower costs - Monthly costs can work our cheaper than renting privately. Book your viewing today! Local area information North Peckham offers a mix of creativity, culture and community spirit. Spend weekends exploring Burgess Park (4 mins' walk away), catching exhibitions at South London Gallery, or trying local favourites from Peckham Levels to Rye Lane Market. For fitness fans Peckham has a wide range of gyms for all different interests. A little further in Bermondsey, explore the beer mile for undiscovered craft lagers, uncover hidden gems at Bermondsey antique market and immerse yourself in culture at the White Cube Gallery. In Elephant and Castle, check out the renowned Southwark Playhouse, BFI IMAX and many more bars and restaurants. Transport at Glengall Rise Packham Rye station is only 9 minutes away from your new home by bike. From there you can reach London Victoria in 13 minutes. Or, Elephant and Castle train station is a 9-minute bike ride away, from where you can get to: Liverpool Street in 13 minutes Farringdon in 9 minutes London Bridge in 4 minutes Nearest Bus stops St George's Way, Bird in Bush Road, and Trafalgar Avenue are within a 4-7 minute walk, served by multiple routes including the 149, 257, 294, 63, 78 and more All travel times and distances taken grom googlemaps.com and are subject to change. *£125 reservation fee is only available for those who attend the event on the 17th October, 2026. To qualify, the memorandum of sale must be issued before the 1st November, 2026. You cannot own another property at the time of completing your purchase. You must have an offer on your current property to be able to reserve a new home. A new collection of 1, 2 & 3 bedroom Shared Ownership apartments in North Peckham. The purchaser pays a mortgage on the share they own and pays rent to a housing association on the remaining share. The combined mortgage and rent is usually less than you’d expect to pay if you bought a similar property outright although this is not a guarantee. To be eligible for shared ownership you would need to meet the following criteria: • Your annual household income does not exceed £90,000. • You have a deposit of at least 5% of the share value • You do not own another property or have your name on the deeds or a mortgage for a property worldwide. • This will be your only residence. • You are a permanent UK resident or have indefinite right to remain. *Service charges are estimated and may subject to change. Rent and service charges will be reviewed annually by your housing provider, usually on 1st April each year. ** This home can also be purchased outright (100% of the value) which is £300,000 and a purchaser would not need to meet the eligibility criteria listed above. 780387:1763.0.description: Experience contemporary East London living in this beautifully designed one-bedroom apartment, perfectly suited for first-time buyers through the Shared Ownership Scheme. This stylish home offers a bright open-plan living and dining area, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The modern kitchen provides ample space for cooking, while large windows fill the home with natural light. Step out onto your private balcony, the perfect spot to enjoy your morning coffee or unwind after a long day. The spacious bedroom provides a calm retreat, and the sleek bathroom and quality finishes throughout make this apartment move-in ready. Why you will love living here: Enjoy the very best of Hackney living in a vibrant and well-connected neighbourhood. Spend weekends exploring Chatsworth Road Market, Millfields Park, and Hackney Marshes, or discover the area’s unique mix of cafés, restaurants, and boutiques. With its creative energy and community charm, Hackney offers a lifestyle that’s full of character and connection. Well Connected: Getting around London is easy and convenient. Clapton Overground Station is just a 5-minute walk away, while Lea Bridge Overground Station is approximately 15 minutes on foot, providing excellent connections to Liverpool Street, Stratford, Highbury & Islington, and beyond. Excellent local bus routes and cycling paths make exploring the city simple and convenient. For leisure and lifestyle, Lea Bridge Horse Riding Centre and the Lee Valley Ice Centre are nearby, offering fantastic opportunities for outdoor activities and family fun just minutes from home. Who is Shared Ownership for? Shared Ownership is designed to help first-time buyers and those without a current home take their first step onto the property ladder. You purchase a share of your new home and pay rent on the remaining share, making it a more affordable way to own compared to buying outright. At YMCC House, you can purchase a minimum 35% share, with the option to buy more over time, known as staircasing, until you own 100% of your home. Pricing: Full Market Value: £400,000 Service Charge: £222.58 per month Monthly Rent: £745.23 Modern design, excellent connections, and a thriving East London community make this apartment at YMCC House the perfect choice for first-time buyers ready to experience the best of Hackney living through Shared Ownership. 784259:1655.0.description: Beautifully Presented One-Bedroom Ground-Floor Apartment with Private Balcony & Courtyard Set within the small and welcoming Bookbinders Court development, this stylish one-bedroom ground-floor apartment offers a great combination of generous living space, excellent storage and two private outdoor spaces. With just 10 apartments in the development, Bookbinders Court has a friendly, community feel that is often hard to find in central London. Recently redecorated and thoughtfully improved, the apartment is ready to move into and enjoy. Bright, Semi Open-Plan Living At the heart of the home is a spacious semi open-plan kitchen and living area, with a southern exposure, creating a sociable and flexible space for everyday life. Whether cooking, entertaining friends or simply relaxing at the end of the day, the open layout makes the apartment feel comfortable and connected. The living area is generously sized, with plenty of room for a large sofa, dining space and additional furniture without feeling overcrowded. The kitchen sits neatly within the semi open-plan layout, with good cupboard and worktop space and a clean, contemporary finish. At the front of the property, a private balcony provides an additional outdoor area and a lovely spot to sit outside with a morning coffee. A Bedroom with Exceptional Storage The good-sized double bedroom has recently been refreshed and offers a calm retreat from the main living area. One of its standout features is the newly installed full-height built-in wardrobe, which runs along much of one side of the room and provides a fantastic amount of concealed storage. Despite this, there is still plenty of space for a double bed and additional furniture. The apartment also benefits from useful storage elsewhere, helping to keep the main living spaces uncluttered. Your Own Private Courtyard To the rear is one of the apartment’s most appealing features: a private enclosed courtyard. It provides a peaceful outdoor space with plenty of room for seating, plants or outdoor dining, and makes a lovely extension of the home during the warmer months. There is also a small garden shed, offering more storage. Together with the balcony at the front, it gives the apartment the unusual benefit of private outdoor space on both sides of the property. A Well-Presented Bathroom The bathroom is a good size and has a smart, contemporary finish, with a large mirror, heated towel rail and plenty of practical surface and storage space. Practical Features for Everyday Living The apartment has been designed with day-to-day living in mind, with excellent storage throughout and the convenience of being on the ground floor. The development also benefits from solar panels which help provide energy-efficient hot water, as well as secure gated bicycle storage. One of the real highlights of Bookbinders Court is the large communal roof terrace, which provides additional outdoor space for residents to enjoy and has spectacular views across the City and London skyline. It’s a great spot to sit out on a summer evening and enjoy the view. A Small Development with a Real Community Feel Bookbinders Court is home to just 10 apartments, creating a much more personal atmosphere than a large residential development. The building has a genuinely friendly group of neighbours and a welcoming sense of community, while still allowing everyone to enjoy the privacy of their own home. East London on Your Doorstep The apartment is ideally positioned for enjoying some of East London’s best-known neighbourhoods. Brick Lane, Shoreditch, Spitalfields Market and Columbia Road Flower Market are all within easy reach, alongside a huge choice of independent cafés, restaurants, pubs, shops and cultural spaces. Despite being so close to everything East London has to offer, the apartment itself provides a comfortable place to come home to and unwind. Excellent Transport Connections The location is particularly well connected for travelling across London: · Bethnal Green Overground Station – approximately 4 minutes’ walk · Bethnal Green Underground Station – approximately 6 minutes’ walk, providing Central Line services · Whitechapel Station – approximately 10 minutes’ walk, with access to the Elizabeth Line, London Overground, District Line and Hammersmith & City Line The City, Canary Wharf, Stratford, the West End and beyond are all within easy reach. A London Home with Something Extra With its spacious open-plan living area, substantial built-in storage, private front balcony and secluded rear courtyard, this apartment offers much more than the typical one-bedroom London flat. Add in the recently refreshed interior, energy-efficient hot water, a large communal roof terrace with fantastic City views and the friendly atmosphere of a small development, and it’s a home that combines city living with comfort, outdoor space and a genuine sense of community. From your door, arrive at major transport hubs across Hounslow, London, and beyond. Get to Clapham Junction in 14 minutes and London Waterloo in under 30 minutes.* Why buy at KEWB? - Modern apartments with bright, spacious open-plan living areas - Kew Bridge and Gunnersbury stations are both nearby severing South Western and Overground train services and the District line - Nestled between Kew Gardens and Gunnersbury Park - 2-bedroom wheelchair adaptable homes available 1-Bedroom Shared Ownership apartment cost breakdown example - 25% share* - Full market value = £427,500 - 25% share price = £106,875 - Estimated monthly mortgage = £521 - Estimated monthly rent = £588 - Estimated monthly service charge = £219 - Estimated total monthly cost = £1,328 What is Shared Ownership? Shared Ownership is a government-backed part buy, part rent scheme that helps you to purchase a home that otherwise may not have been affordable. Through Shared Ownership, you can purchase a ‘share’ of a home, typically between 25% and 75%, and pay rent on the remaining amount. Then, over time, you can purchase more shares all the way up to 100%, or simply sell your home on the open market. What's more, your deposit is based on the value of the share you buy, not the full market value, making these high-spec homes even more affordable when compared to buying a home outright. 787226:1609.0.description: Come and celebrate 125 years of Southern Housing with us on Saturday, 17th October at 12pm. A special open day for you to enjoy drinks, delicious cakes, good vibes and a little something to take home, plus a special £125 reservation fee on the day*. Make this a moment that matters, and take the next step towards creating many more in your new home. Book your space! Wickside is finally here - a landmark regeneration of East London's most creative, independent districts - Hackney Wick. Get the first glimpse at Wickside! The first Shared Ownership homes launching off-plan will be 1, 2 and 3 bedroom apartments at Bridge House, designed by award-winning architects Studio Shaw. Think canal walks, good coffee spots, independent studios and that neighbourhood feel people love about Hackney Wick. Benefits of living at Wickside Quality homes with SMEG appliances included Every apartment has its own balcony or terrace There's a rooftop garden with a small play area for kids Hackney Wick Station is only a 4-minute walk away The Hertford Union Canal is on your doorstep What makes Bridge House feel different is that it's not just a block of apartments. These new build homes in Hackney Wick have been designed to feel lived-in and connected, with homes sitting alongside creative workspaces and businesses coming in the future. There's also a brand-new bridge just outside Bridge House which links you more easily to Fish Island, so it all feels much more open and connected. It's the kind of place where you can grab a coffee nearby, walk along the canal on a Sunday morning, work from home during the week and still feel like there's a buzz around you. The wider seven-acre neighbourhood brings together 300 homes, dynamic commercial spaces, green spaces and quieter residents' communal areas that make everyday life balanced. Shared Ownership What are the benefits? Low deposit - you only pay from 5% of the share you are buying. Flexibility - you choose when you want to purchase extra share of your home. Accessibility - Shared Ownership helps you get a mortgage even with a lower salary. Lower costs - Monthly costs can work our cheaper than renting privately. To be eligible for Shared Ownership: Your household income must be no more than £90,000. You cannot own another property at the time of completing your purchase. You must have an offer on your current property to be able to reserve a new home. You must be over 18 years of age and able to obtain a mortgage. Wheelchair adaptable apartments Wickside will offer a number of wheelchair adaptable apartments, designed to make living in London the best it can be. With great layout options that accommodate wheelchair users, rest assured you will find the perfect home. Speak to our sales team to find out more. Read more about our adaptable apartments here. Book your appointment! *£125 reservation fee is only available for those who attend the event on the 17th October, 2026. To qualify, the memorandum of sale must be issued before the 1st November, 2026. Read full description Less description
